clues: This city is in the East Bay part of the San Francisco Bay Area. It lies in the west of Contra Costa County, in California.
Fall brings this city's warmest days, not high summer. September tops the year for heat, while January is its coldest month.
On August 3, 1905, this place was made a city in law. It still runs its own council to this day.
For one short stretch, this city runs up to San Francisco on Red Rock Island. The island sits in the bay by that big city.
This city is one of just two that sit on the shores of two bays at once. One bay is San Francisco Bay, and one is San Pablo Bay.
